# Proof & Realness

Legend: [D] demonstrated · [A] anticipated · [T] target.

- [A] "There should be a lot of metrics there about demographics, the other and scientific stuff," and "you can go and listen to it" (asserted as the proof, not shown within the transcript).
- [A] You can "tell my family over dinner and then not laugh at it," met with "why haven't we got it already?" rather than "what the fuck are you talking about?"
- [T] "To actually have some Indigenous people actually sign up," since "they hate all this stuff," used as "a good indicator."
- [T] "Immediate actions after these assemblies that genuinely change things," interviewees "get emotional because their genuine local environment has changed," captured "before deep thought happens."
- [A] "Measure them fulfilling their pledges," verified by hours spent; failure "decreases the whole identity reputation"; "allocating money based on whether the team... actually do do it."
- [D] One NGO "run one online with like 400 people" (prior, not this milestone).

**Headline metric.** Verified pledge fulfilment, hours actually spent, tracked in the Genesis trust graphs.
